name: missing-prefix
description: QR string missing the LFQR: prefix — must reject with INVALID_PREFIX.

name: invalid-base45-chars
description: Payload contains characters not in the base45 alphabet (! is invalid) — must reject with INVALID_BASE45.

name: truncated-base45
description: A single base45 character after the prefix — length ≡ 1 (mod 3) — must reject with INVALID_BASE45.

name: empty-after-prefix
description: Nothing after the LFQR: prefix — empty base45 decodes to empty bytes — CBOR decode fails.
